name: Transaction deadline check
summary: Every Monday, and whenever a contract is amended, the transaction coordinator gets one page from the open-transactions export: what falls due soon, by agent; what has passed with no completion recorded; which dates are missing or impossible; and a question for each agent. It reads dates as recorded and counts none.

sources.title: FullyPowered AI's own original method for a brokerage's weekly check of recorded transaction milestones.
